Creating a podcast used to require audio equipment, hours of editing, and voice recording. Now, it takes just minutes.

Write your topic or idea and the app will generate a well-structured, engaging script using advanced AI models trained for storytelling and narration.

3. High-Quality MP3 Export
Once generated, your podcast can be instantly exported as an MP3 audio file — ready for uploading to Spotify, Apple Podcasts, or any platform you use.

4. Script Export in Text and PDF
Download the written script for review, editing, or publishing on a blog, newsletter, or website.

5. Easy Sharing
Share your podcast files directly to messaging apps, email, cloud drives, or social media in just one tap.

6. Intros, Outros, and Music Integration
Add custom intros, outros, or background music to give your podcast a signature sound and enhance listener engagement.

7. Cloud-based Podcast Library
Access all your past creations in one place. Edit, re-generate, or download them anytime.

8. Multilingual Support
Generate scripts and podcasts in multiple languages, making your content truly global.

Ideal For:
• Podcasters and YouTubers
• Educators and online instructors
• Influencers and motivational speakers
• Coaches, mentors, and consultants
• Business professionals and marketers
• Journalists and news reporters
• Creatives and storytellers
• Students and hobbyists

App Benefits:
• Save time and money — no need for recording studios or editing tools
• Consistently generate professional-level content
• Grow your brand or audience with minimal effort
• Eliminate "podcaster’s block" with AI-generated ideas and scripts
• Publish on your terms — anywhere, anytime

record.description_evidence:
No surprises: cancel Premium anytime, restore purchases in one tap, and every free limit is spelled out below.
When nine shows cover the same story, you'll know — Bubbling shows you, and jumps to the minute each one gets to it.
Free: your first 3 summaries need no account. Sign up free for 5 new summaries every month.

PodSized turns long podcast episodes into structured summaries you can read in about five minutes — then keeps them, organized, so you can come back to what you learned.

— WHAT'S FREE, EXACTLY —

• 3 summaries with no account at all
• With a free account: 5 new summaries every month
• Every summary you unlock stays in your library, synced across your devices
• The full timestamped transcript and the chapter outline for each summary you unlock
• One-tap export to Obsidian, Notion, Logseq, Readwise or NotebookLM
• Your Feed and Bubbling
• Your first audio summary is on us, so you can hear it before you pay

— WHAT PREMIUM ADDS ($4.99/month) —

• Unlimited summaries
• Audio summaries: a roughly five-minute spoken version of the episode
• Radio: your newest audio summaries, back to back, hands-free
• Play the thread: one story, stitched together from every show that covered it
• AI chat with any episode, or with a show's whole back catalog
• CarPlay

Cancel anytime from Manage Subscription in the app's account menu, or from your Apple ID settings. Restore Purchases is in Settings and on the Premium screen. Premium is tied to your PodSized account, so it follows you when you sign in on another device.

— BUBBLING: THE STORY ACROSS SHOWS —

When many independent podcasts pick up the same story, PodSized groups them into one card: how many shows covered it, which ones you follow, and when the whole conversation is happening outside your feed ("9 shows covered this — none in your feed").

Tap in and "Also covered this" lists the shows you don't follow, each with a timecode that drops you straight into the moment it discusses the story. Bubbling is free.

— A LEARNING SYSTEM, NOT JUST A PLAYER —

CAPTURE
Follow the shows you care about. New episodes from popular shows are summarized as they come out. For anything else, unlock an episode yourself; it's usually ready in under a minute.

READ THE NOTES
Every summary is structured: headers, key points and direct quotes, built for skimming. The timestamped outline shows where each topic lives, and tapping a timestamp jumps you there in the episode.

ORGANIZE
Your Feed lists the latest summaries from every show you follow, newest first, with a clear end point so you know when you're caught up. Your Library keeps everything you've unlocked, with sort and search.

EXPORT
Copy any summary as Markdown for Obsidian, Logseq or Notion, or send it to NotebookLM or Readwise from the share sheet. The episode link, outline and quotes come with it.

REVISIT
Transcripts are timestamped so you can find the exact line again. With Premium, ask the episode a follow-up question, or ask a whole show what it has said about a topic, and get answers that cite the episodes they came from.

— FOR BACKLOGS AND COMMUTES —

• Triage a backlog in minutes: read the summary, then decide whether the full episode deserves 90 minutes
• Every Feed row shows two lengths, the summary's and the full episode's, and plays either one
• Premium: Radio plays your audio summaries back to back, and CarPlay puts them on your dashboard

— WHO IT'S FOR —

PodSized is built for people who listen to learn: business, technology, investing, science, health, news and history. Coverage is deepest in business and technology.

Available on iPhone, Android and the web, with one account across all three.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://podsized.io/privacy

BUILT FOR PODCAST LOVERS

Download Herd and enjoy a better way to listen to podcasts.

record.description_evidence:
Turn anything into a podcast — in minutes.

Podgeno transforms your documents, notes, or any topic into professional-quality podcasts using AI. Whether you're a student studying for exams, a professional staying on top of industry trends, or someone who simply prefers listening over reading — Podgeno has you covered.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Enter a topic, paste text, or upload a document (PDF, DOC, TXT)
2. Choose your podcast style, duration, and AI host
3. Tap Generate — your podcast is ready in minutes

CHOOSE YOUR STYLE
Pick from 6 podcast formats to match your purpose:
- Conversational — Like chatting with a knowledgeable friend
- Educational — Clear, structured explanations
- Storytelling — Narrative-driven with engaging hooks
- News Briefing — Concise, fact-focused updates
- Deep Dive — Thorough analysis with multiple perspectives
- Debate — Two perspectives, pros and cons

MEET YOUR AI HOSTS
8 unique AI personalities with distinct voices and speaking styles. Mix and match for dialogue format — two hosts discussing your topic naturally.

PICK YOUR DURATION
- Quick (3-4 min) — Key takeaways only
- Balanced (5-6 min) — Standard coverage
- Detailed (7-10 min) — Comprehensive exploration

MONOLOGUE OR DIALOGUE
Single host for focused delivery, or two hosts for dynamic conversation — you decide.

UPLOAD ANYTHING
- PDF, DOC, DOCX, TXT documents
- Images (OCR text extraction)
- Or just type/paste your topic

BUILT FOR LEARNERS
- Study notes to audio revision
- Research papers to digestible podcasts
- Lecture materials to listen-on-the-go content
- Industry reports to commute-friendly audio

Subscription options available. Token-based system — you choose what to create, when to create it.

Questions or feedback? We'd love to hear from you.

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
- Podgeno offers auto-renewable subscriptions for premium access
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period
- Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings after purchase
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription

Tell it who you are in one sentence. It builds your feed, gets sharper every day, and works around the clock. Not another news app — it's the agent that reads everything, so you don't have to.
YOUR WORLD, FULLY COVERED Newsrooms, podcasts, blogs, GitHub, research papers, newsletters — Zetik follows them all and distills them into one clean, personal briefing.
A FEED THAT TAKES FEEDBACK Too much of something? Just say so — "less celebrity coverage, more tech news" — and your feed reshapes itself instantly.

MEMORY YOU CAN SEE AND SHAPE Zetik remembers your interests, your feedback, your taste — out in the open. See every memory, see how it formed, edit or delete anything, anytime. You're not training a black box. You're building it together.
Your time is the scarcest thing you have. Zetik reads everything, so you read only what matters.
Download Zetik — and meet the agent already working for you.

record.description_evidence:
Introducing Layla, the groundbreaking personal AI that resides directly on your phone or device. No internet connection required, no censorship, complete privacy.

No information leaves your device.

Features:
- General knowledge: ask Layla about anything under the sun, she will give you an informed response
- Just chatting: Layla has many personalities you can choose; from cute to serious to bubbly to stoic, you can talk with her however you want
- Memory: tell Layla about yourself, she'll remember you
- Personalisation: you can create your own characters if none of our presets fit your style!
- Voices: over 100+ different voices to choose from for your characters
- Group chats: engage in conversation with multiple characters!
- Agents: Layla supports programmable agents using Python
- Custom AI: load custom GGUF models that fit your needs
- Additional features available as free plugins: downloading different personalities, advanced settings

Note: The app downloads a 4GB Large Language Model (LLM / brains of the AI) after the it starts for the first time. This is only needed once. This technology is VERY new, right now we only support the latest flagship phones (8GB+ RAM). If your phone does not meet the minimum requirements, you may experience degraded performance. We are working hard to bring Layla to more devices.

DISCLAIMER:
Layla is a generative language model. All her answers come from inputs you give her. This means her information may be inaccurate, outdated, or otherwise unsuitable for your situation. Layla is designed for purely entertainment purposes and her output should not be taken seriously.

IMPORTANT:
Local AI is an emerging technology and requires the latest flagship phones to run. BEFORE YOU BUY: check your device compatibility, please visit: https://www.layla-network.ai/contact
